name: Greater Night Lord’s Eye (Gaze, Vampire)
body:
Your gaze can do more than simply scare your victims, but can completely disable them.

Prerequisite(s): Night Lord’s Eye, cruomancer level 9th.

Benefit(s): Whenever you use your Night Lord’s Eye feat, you may choose to spend 5 blood points, instead of the normal amount. If you do, then the effect imposed by your gaze becomes more powerful. The exact effect depends on the difference between your cruomancer level and the target’s Hit Dice, as indicated on the table below. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.

Table: Greater Night Lord’s Eye
Your Cruomancer Level	Effect
Target’s Hit Dice + 1-2	Staggered for 2d4 rounds
Target’s Hit Dice + 3-4	Dazed for 2d4 rounds
Target’s Hit Dice + 5-6	Stunned for 2d4 minutes
Equal to or less than target’s Hit Dice	Nauseated for 1 round
Target’s Hit Dice + 7 or more	Paralyzed for 2d4 minutes

If you have the Enhanced Gaze feat, then whenever you activate this ability, you may choose to spend 12 blood points, instead of the normal amount. If you do, then you can affect each creature in a 30-ft. cone, rather than only affecting a single creature.
